description: Start or resume payment for this exact prepared order and revision. Show the exact amount and returned action_url for the buyer to connect Link, approve this purchase or complete bank authentication. Only the buyer can approve; never ask for payment credentials in chat. Call again after that step, respecting retry_after_seconds. Confirm payment only when status is paid; processing and requires_action are incomplete. Changing the order requires a new quote and approval. Use read_order for separate printing and mailing progress.

expected_revision.description: Parent order.revision for the exact purchase shown to the buyer, returned by prepare_order, revise_order or read_order. A mismatch fails with CONFLICT; read the order and obtain approval for any changed purchase.

order_access_token.description: Exact private order_access_token returned by prepare_order or revise_order for this order. Keep it secret; never invent it or put it in a public URL or log.

order_id.description: Parent order.id returned by prepare_order, revise_order or read_order. Use the matching order_access_token; a card ID cannot identify the purchase.
